quote.text: What homeschool records am I actually required to keep

promise.text: How to verify homeschool requirements by state

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "homeschool"

lines.text: Verify your homeschool route using official state sources and three limited examples.
This is not an exhaustive 50-state legal summary.

eyebrow.text: Build a requirement record you can actually use

items.text: Write the state, child's age or grade, education route and school year at the top.
Record the notice or application recipient, current form, filing trigger and deadline.
List attendance, days, hours or subject requirements only where the relevant official rule calls for them.
Separate records retained at home from material submitted annually or produced on request.
Record assessment options, who can assess, covered grades, due date and where evidence goes.
Find retention requirements and any rules for moving, ending a program or returning to school.

line.text: Name your state and the printed record carries what it asks for, each line set against what you have already recorded.
